t: PSX Characters Sampler: 18 Free Low Poly 3D Characters
s: 18 free PS1 style low poly characters, rigged, 45 clips each, for Godot and Unity
d:
From the same studio: the PSX Character Library holds the CSAF PSX character packs on one page, plus every new one, for $19.99.

PSX Characters Sampler is 18 free low poly PS1 style 3D characters for Godot 4, Unity and Unreal, each rigged with 45 animation clips. A mechanic, a knight, a high priest, a rifleman, an innkeeper, a station engineer, a plague doctor, a marine sergeant, an orc warrior, a patrol officer, a nutcracker soldier, a shambler, a construction worker, a head nurse, the stranger, a scavenger, a syndicate boss and a British rifleman: one from each of our eighteen paid PSX packs, 55 palette skins in all, 1494 to 1499 triangles per character and one 256 px texture per skin, in GLB, FBX, OBJ and Blender formats. Free to use in any number of commercial games, no attribution required.

What is inside

18 characters · 55 skins · 45 clips and a T-pose on each · GLB, FBX, OBJ and the Blender source · 256 px PNG textures in 15 bit colour · a PSX shader for Godot 4.

  • Mechanic from Last Shift (survival horror): 1497 triangles, 4 skins.
  • Knight from Ironvale (fantasy): 1499 triangles, 3 skins.
  • High priest from Hollow Congregation (occult horror): 1495 triangles, 3 skins.
  • Rifleman from Fort Vale (modern military): 1496 triangles, 3 skins.
  • Innkeeper from Greyhollow (medieval townsfolk): 1497 triangles, 3 skins.
  • Station engineer from Deep Station (sci-fi horror): 1499 triangles, 3 skins.
  • Plague doctor from Pale Hours (supernatural horror): 1496 triangles, 3 skins.
  • Marine sergeant from Outpost (sci-fi colony): 1496 triangles, 3 skins.
  • Orc warrior from Grimsnout (orc and goblin): 1499 triangles, 3 skins.
  • Patrol officer from Night Beat (police): 1496 triangles, 3 skins.
  • Nutcracker soldier from Hollyfrost (Christmas): 1498 triangles, 3 skins.
  • Shambler from Blackwater (infected and zombie): 1496 triangles, 3 skins.
  • Construction worker from Crosstown (modern city): 1498 triangles, 3 skins.
  • Head nurse from Saint Oswin (asylum horror): 1498 triangles, 3 skins.
  • The stranger from Camp Redfern (summer camp horror): 1497 triangles, 3 skins.
  • Scavenger from Ashfall (post-apocalyptic): 1497 triangles, 3 skins.
  • Syndicate boss from Syndicate (crime syndicate): 1494 triangles, 3 skins.
  • British rifleman from Foxhole (WW2): 1497 triangles, 3 skins.
  • The clips: idle, walk, sprint, crouch, jump, punches, sword, pistol, spells, hits, death, sit, swim, interact and more.
  • The shader (godot_psx.gdshader): vertex snapping, affine texture warp, 15 bit colour with dithering and fog, every setting a slider.

Every skin in Godot 4 with the included shader: garments recoloured, skin tones kept.

Works with

Godot 4: copy models/ and shaders/ into the project, instance a _skin0.glb and put the shader on the mesh. Tested in a blank Godot 4.7.2 project under Forward+, Compatibility and Mobile: every GLB imports and every clip plays. Unity 6 and Unreal 5: import the FBX (humanoid skeleton and clips included) and set point filtering in Unity, nearest in Unreal. Those two engines were not run here; Blender re-imported every FBX with all 53 bones and every clip.

The full packs

Each pack uses the same skeleton, clips and shader, so the full casts drop into the same scene. 18 packs on 10 pages. List prices $7.99 to $9.99. All eighteen are also on one page, the PSX Character Library ($19.99), with every new pack added.

  • Greyhollow + Hollyfrost: Greyhollow (14 medieval townsfolk characters x 3 skins) + Hollyfrost (14 Christmas characters x 3 skins), both in one purchase, $8.99.
  • Deep Station: 14 sci-fi horror characters x 3 skins, $7.99.

Licence and how it was made

Use the models in any number of commercial or non-commercial games, no attribution required, and modify them freely. Do not resell or redistribute the models themselves as assets. The skeleton and clips are the CC0 Quaternius Universal Animation Library; the bodies come from MakeHuman (CC0 output).

Made with AI tools: the bodies are built in code and their textures painted by AI image models over their own renders; the code and the cover art were made with AI. Code: yes. Graphics: yes. Sounds: no. Text: no.

1.10.0 (November 16, 2026): the British rifleman from Foxhole joins. 1.9.0 (November 14, 2026): the syndicate boss from Syndicate joins. 1.2.1 (October 30, 2026): the knight, rifleman and station engineer were rebuilt on new bodies; download again if your copy is older. The other versions are described in the devlogs on this page.

u:
New in 1.10.0: the British rifleman from Foxhole joins the free PSX Characters Sampler, which now has 18 characters, one from each of our eighteen paid PSX packs.

Blackwater and Camp Redfern are sold on the Last Shift page, all three casts in one purchase; Saint Oswin is sold on the Hollow Congregation page, both casts in one purchase; Crosstown, Ashfall, Syndicate and Foxhole are sold on the Fort Vale page, all five casts in one purchase; Hollyfrost is sold on the Greyhollow page, both casts in one purchase. Each of those pages also has its own free sampler file for each cast.

Every character comes with the same files its full pack ships: a GLB with all 45 animation clips and the reference T pose, a GLB per extra skin, FBX with clips, OBJ, 256 px textures and the Blender source. Across the eighteen that is 55 skins. Each file is byte for byte the one in the paid pack.

We ran the tests again on the new download: a blank Godot 4.7.2 project imported every GLB, the PSX shader compiled on all 18 characters under Forward+, Compatibility and Mobile, and Blender imported every FBX (all 53 bones and every clip) and every OBJ back in. Unity and Unreal were not run here.

The full packs: Last Shift + Blackwater + Camp Redfern (41 characters, $9.99), Ironvale (14 characters, $7.99), Hollow Congregation + Saint Oswin (28 characters, $8.99), Fort Vale + Crosstown + Ashfall + Syndicate + Foxhole (70 characters, $9.99), Greyhollow + Hollyfrost (28 characters, $8.99), Deep Station (14 characters, $7.99), Pale Hours (14 characters, $7.99), Outpost (14 characters, $7.99), Grimsnout (14 characters, $7.99), Night Beat (14 characters, $7.99). Those are list prices: as we post this, seven of the ten pages are 30% off (Last Shift + Blackwater + Camp Redfern $6.99, Ironvale $5.59, Hollow Congregation + Saint Oswin $6.29, Greyhollow + Hollyfrost $6.29, Deep Station $5.59, Pale Hours $5.59, Grimsnout $5.59).

Every character was made with AI tools: bodies built by scripts an AI system wrote, textures painted by AI image models and projected onto the mesh.
